Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

schema.description: One-way signal from a member's key holder to the client that asked it to watch a room with rooms/keys/watch: the room's host signalled (rooms/changed) that the room has moved past the version the client had read to. The room, the member and host the watch was armed for, and the room's latest version — nothing about what changed. There is no #response form. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

ext.description: Ecosystem-defined extension members per SPEC.md §4.5.1. A key holder MUST NOT put anything here about what changed.

host.description: The host the watch was armed at, and that signalled: where to read the room.

latestVersion.description: The host signal's latestVersion, unaltered. A hint for the reader, who learns what changed only by reading.

member.description: The member the watch was armed as, as the client named it: the persona to read the room as.

roomId.description: The room, exactly as the host's signal named it — which is as the client named it in rooms/keys/watch.

schema.title: Rooms Keys — Changed — payload
